name: Sparkrender
senses: Blindsight 10 ft., darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 14
traits:
Final boss at Clifftop Observatory (D5–D6). Skinny for a wyrmling; scales glitter; lightning arcs around horns and snout.

Plans a ritual when the King-Killer Star comet is nearest — bind spirits of dead dragons using Aidron as sacrifice.

Has a dozen+ kobold minions. Can negotiate but is cruel and haughty.
actions:
Multiattack: One bite attack.

Bite. Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (1d10+3) piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) lightning damage.

Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6). 30-foot line, 5 ft. wide. DC 12 Dex save or 22 (4d10) lightning damage, half on success.
notes:
Blue dragon wyrmling — grandson of the dragon Runara killed. Adjust HP/attacks for party size (Sly Flourish recommends dials for 4+ PCs).

Prisoner: Aidron (bronze wyrmling) in the tower.
